Senior Backend Engineer — Platform Team

We're looking for a senior backend engineer to join our platform team. You'll own core infrastructure that serves millions of requests per day and enables 50+ engineers to ship faster.

What you'll do:
- Design and build scalable APIs and internal services in Python/FastAPI
- Lead technical projects end-to-end, from design doc to production
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering culture
- Improve developer experience through tooling and documentation

What we're looking for:
- 5+ years of backend engineering experience
- Strong Python skills; FastAPI or similar async framework experience
- PostgreSQL and Redis experience at scale
- Docker and Kubernetes for service deployment
- Experience with distributed systems and observability
- A track record of owning impactful projects

Nice to have:
- TypeScript/Node.js for internal tooling
- Experience at a startup or fast-moving team
- Open source contributions

We're a startup (~80 people), Series B, remote-first. We move fast and value engineers who can think from first principles.
